title: Temporary configurations
lead: Access to one server for 12 hours to 3 days, tied to no one's profile: for a guest or a check. It ends by itself.
created: The configuration is being made on the node.
revoke_confirm_vless: Revoke access to this configuration? New connections are blocked; open ones may last until they disconnect.
vless_notice: After expiry or revocation new connections are blocked. Existing connections may continue until they disconnect.
unavailable_node_changed: the server's settings changed since; revoke it and make a new one
